_comment: Held-out corpus. Written on 2026-09-08 in the same sitting as the vocabulary extension that followed the first corpus, but from a different prompt (how cloud, devops, finance and HR APIs name their operations) and not checked against the vocabulary while being written. Its purpose is to estimate what the first corpus cannot: how much of the gap an extension closes on words it was not written against. 'effect' is what each tool really does; null is harmless.

tools.name: terminate_instance
tools.description: Terminates a running compute instance.

tools.name: decommission_host
tools.description: Takes a host out of the fleet for good.

tools.name: evict_tenant
tools.description: Evicts a tenant and frees its allocated storage.

tools.name: scrub_records
tools.description: Scrubs the matching records from the archive.

tools.name: void_transaction
tools.description: Voids a settled transaction.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancels the customer's subscription at the end of the period.

tools.name: suspend_account
tools.description: Suspends an account so it can no longer sign in.

tools.name: disable_user
tools.description: Disables a user across all connected applications.

tools.name: grant_role
tools.description: Grants a role to a principal in the given project.

tools.name: promote_release
tools.description: Promotes a release candidate to the production channel.

tools.name: rollback_deployment
tools.description: Rolls the deployment back to the previous revision.

tools.name: restart_service
tools.description: Restarts the named service on every node.

tools.name: scale_cluster
tools.description: Scales the cluster to the requested node count.

tools.name: invite_member
tools.description: Invites a person to the workspace by email address.

tools.name: broadcast_announcement
tools.description: Broadcasts an announcement to every member of the organisation.

tools.name: escalate_ticket
tools.description: Escalates a ticket to the on-call engineer.

tools.name: wire_funds
tools.description: Wires funds from the operating account to a beneficiary.

tools.name: settle_invoice
tools.description: Settles an outstanding invoice from the account on file.

tools.name: reveal_secret
tools.description: Reveals the plaintext value of a stored secret.

tools.name: impersonate_user
tools.description: Issues a session that acts as the given user.

tools.name: replicate_bucket
tools.description: Replicates the bucket to a bucket in another region.

tools.name: offload_logs
tools.description: Offloads rotated logs to the external log provider.

tools.name: measure_latency
tools.description: Measures round-trip latency to the given host.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Renders a preview image of the document.

tools.name: validate_schema
tools.description: Validates a document against its schema.

tools.name: lint_config
tools.description: Lints a configuration file and lists the problems found.

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimates the monthly cost of the described resources.

tools.name: classify_text
tools.description: Classifies a piece of text into one of the known categories.
